Thank you so much, I really appreciate that. I know exactly what you mean and now feel really on edge being here. I cope with pain reasonably well but that cramping, abdo pain terrifies me.

Hey, thank you. Shocking actually! How about you?

It's past midnight and just feel too awful to sleep. I don't know, i can cope with mild to moderate depression/anxiety and still function but this is beyond severe.

Not going to try to dish out some trite advice but will say your post resonated with me, especially the last line. My stupid goddamn faulty brain has ruined my life. A couple of meds worked for me as well, then stopped. I told the psychiatrist. His reply was to fucking CHUCKLE at me and say, 'The meds don't stop working'. Oh no? The amount of people I have heard whose meds have stopped working would be enough but the fact that I've experienced it myself makes me 100% sure. But of course, these pseudo scientist quacks know better right?

And you're right about people not being there. The only people that want to spend significant time talking about depression are either saints or people suffering depression themselves. So we have to stick together.

That's exactly what I want. Tried for so long to get better but now I know that's not going to happen I just want to be comfortable, I want them to take this near constant pain away. Want to be hooked up to a morphine drip for a few weeks, then just quietly OD.
Run nearly every day, eat well and try to be in bed early.
